args.name: Lantern Night — 14 November 2026 — Willow Park Bristol

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical event promo, designed as an animated event poster with exceptionally clear large typography. After dark in a beautiful park, many warm golden glowing paper lanterns hang safely from tree branches, with soft amber bokeh and deep midnight blue surroundings. Gentle breeze sways lanterns, subtle cinematic slow forward camera drift. Inviting magical community event mood. No daylight. No speech, no voiceover, silent video. Throughout the whole clip, show stable, crisp, high-contrast large centered event typography in the foreground, within generous mobile safe margins. Exact text only, with these four lines: 'LANTERN NIGHT' / '14 NOVEMBER 2026' / 'WILLOW PARK,' / 'BRISTOL'. Date and venue must be especially large, legible and prominent, not small captions. Use elegant bold ivory lettering with subtle dark backing for readability over lanterns. Keep all words and spelling unchanged and visible from first frame to last. Restrained beautiful gold framing accents. No other text, no logos, no invented start time. Finish with a gentle warm glow while keeping date and venue fully visible.
